roadmap.title: JavaScript Fundamentals
roadmap.goal: Build a strong foundation in JavaScript syntax, data types, operators, control flow, functions, arrays and objects.

topics.title: JavaScript Basics & Syntax
hands: Create variables using var, let and const.
Practice all JavaScript primitive data types.
Write small programs using strict mode.
interview: What are the primitive data types in JavaScript?

topics.title: Operators & Type Coercion
hands: Predict the output of 30 type-coercion examples.
Build examples using optional chaining and nullish coalescing.
Convert values between strings, numbers and booleans.
interview: What is the difference between null and undefined?
What does typeof return for null?
What is the difference between || and ???

topics.title: Control Flow & Loops
interview: When should you use while instead of for?

topics.title: Functions Fundamentals
hands: Create functions using declaration, expression and arrow syntax.
interview: Can an arrow function be used as a constructor?

topics.title: Arrays & Objects
interview: How does object property lookup work?
What is the difference between copying an object and referencing it?

roadmap.title: Scope, Execution Context & Hoisting
roadmap.goal: Understand how JavaScript code is executed and how variables and functions are resolved.

topics.title: Execution Context
hands: Draw execution contexts for nested function calls.
Predict variable availability at each execution stage.
interview: What happens when a function is called?

topics.title: Scope & Scope Chain
hands: Predict variable resolution in nested functions.
Compare var function scope with let and const block scope.
interview: How does JavaScript find a variable?

topics.title: Hoisting & Temporal Dead Zone
hands: Compare function declarations and function expressions before initialization.
interview: What is the Temporal Dead Zone?
Why can a function declaration be called before its definition?

roadmap.title: Closures, Functions & Functional Programming
roadmap.goal: Master advanced function behavior and functional programming concepts used extensively in modern JavaScript.

topics.title: Closures
hands: Create a closure-based private state implementation.
interview: Why does the returned function remember count?
How can closures cause memory retention?

topics.title: Higher-Order Functions
hands: Create custom map(), filter() and reduce().

topics.title: Currying & Partial Application
hands: Build a reusable validation utility using currying.

topics.title: IIFE & Module Patterns
hands: Convert an IIFE module to ES modules.
interview: Why were IIFEs commonly used before ES modules?

roadmap.title: this, Prototypes & Object-Oriented JavaScript
roadmap.goal: Understand JavaScript's object model, this binding, prototypes and inheritance.

topics.title: this Keyword & Binding
hands: Create examples for every this binding rule.
Implement custom versions of bind(), call() and apply().
Predict this in nested function scenarios.
interview: What determines the value of this?
Arrow function vs normal function this?
Why does this behave differently inside arrow functions?

topics.title: Prototypes & Prototype Chain
hands: Trace property lookup through a prototype chain.
interview: How does the prototype chain work?
How does JavaScript look up object properties?

topics.title: Classes & Inheritance
interview: What happens internally when extends is used?

roadmap.title: Modern JavaScript ES6+
roadmap.goal: Master modern JavaScript syntax and language features used in production applications.

topics.title: ES6+ Core Features
hands: Refactor ES5 code into modern ES6+.
Build utilities using destructuring and spread.
interview: What major features were introduced in ES6?

topics.title: ES Modules
hands: Split an application into ES modules.
interview: How do ES modules help tree shaking?

roadmap.title: Asynchronous JavaScript
roadmap.goal: Understand asynchronous programming, promises and async/await at a deep level.

topics.title: Callbacks & Callback Patterns
interview: Why can callbacks become difficult to maintain?

topics.title: Promises
interview: What are the states of a Promise?
How does Promise error propagation work?

topics.title: Promise Concurrency Methods
hands: Compare all(), allSettled(), race() and any().
interview: When should Promise.all() not be used?

topics.title: async/await
interview: Does async/await create a new thread?
How do you run multiple async operations concurrently?

roadmap.title: Event Loop & JavaScript Runtime
roadmap.goal: Develop a deep understanding of how JavaScript executes synchronous and asynchronous code.

topics.title: Event Loop
hands: Predict execution order before running code.
Trace call stack, microtask queue and task queue.
interview: Why does Promise.then() execute before setTimeout()?

topics.title: Microtasks vs Tasks
hands: Create nested microtask and task examples.
Predict complex Promise and timer execution order.
interview: Which runs first: Promise or setTimeout?

topics.title: JavaScript Runtime Environment
hands: Compare browser and Node.js execution environments.
Identify which APIs are JavaScript language features and which are runtime APIs.
interview: Is the event loop part of JavaScript itself?
What does the browser provide beyond ECMAScript?

roadmap.title: Arrays, Objects & Functional Data Transformation
roadmap.goal: Become highly proficient at manipulating real-world application data using JavaScript.

topics.title: Array Methods
hands: Implement map(), filter() and reduce() from scratch.
interview: Does sort() mutate the original array?
How would you group an array of objects?

topics.title: Object Utilities
hands: Convert objects to arrays and arrays to objects.
interview: How do you check whether an object owns a property?

topics.title: Immutability & Copying
hands: Identify mutation bugs in application code.
interview: What are common ways to clone objects?

roadmap.title: DOM, Browser APIs & Web Platform
roadmap.goal: Master JavaScript APIs used to interact with browsers and web applications.

topics.title: DOM Manipulation
hands: Build a vanilla JavaScript todo application.
Build a modal without a framework.
interview: Why can excessive DOM manipulation hurt performance?

topics.title: DOM Events & Event Propagation
hands: Implement a dynamic list using event delegation.

topics.title: Browser Storage
hands: Build a preference manager using localStorage.
interview: What are security risks of storing sensitive data in browser storage?

topics.title: Fetch API & HTTP Requests
hands: Build a CRUD application using fetch().
Handle loading, success and error states.
interview: How do you cancel fetch requests?
How do you handle API errors?

roadmap.title: Memory Management & Garbage Collection
roadmap.goal: Understand JavaScript memory behavior and diagnose memory leaks in production applications.

topics.title: JavaScript Memory Model
hands: Create examples showing stack and heap behavior.

topics.title: Garbage Collection
hands: Inspect memory snapshots using browser DevTools.
interview: When can an object be garbage collected?

topics.title: Memory Leaks
hands: Create and fix event listener leaks.
Use memory snapshots to identify retained objects.
interview: How can closures cause memory retention?
How do you debug memory leaks?
What is a detached DOM node?

topics.title: WeakMap, WeakSet & Weak References
hands: Experiment with object lifetime in a controlled example.
interview: Why can't WeakMap keys be primitives?

roadmap.title: Advanced JavaScript Language Features
roadmap.goal: Master advanced language capabilities that appear in framework internals, libraries and complex applications.

topics.title: Property Descriptors
interview: What is the difference between enumerable and configurable?

roadmap.title: JavaScript Performance Optimization
roadmap.goal: Learn how to write efficient JavaScript and diagnose runtime performance problems.

topics.title: Memoization & Caching
hands: Measure performance before and after memoization.

topics.title: Runtime & Rendering Performance
interview: How would you optimize expensive JavaScript?

roadmap.title: JavaScript Design Patterns & Architecture
roadmap.goal: Learn reusable JavaScript architecture patterns for maintainable production applications.

topics.title: Module Pattern
hands: Refactor module-pattern code into ES modules.
interview: How do ES modules improve the module pattern?

topics.title: Factory & Builder Patterns
hands: Create a factory for different user types.
interview: When would you use a factory?

topics.title: Observer & Pub/Sub Patterns
interview: How would you implement an EventEmitter?

topics.title: Strategy, Adapter & Facade Patterns
hands: Create a facade around multiple utilities.
interview: What problem does an Adapter solve?

roadmap.title: Practical JavaScript Coding & Polyfills
roadmap.goal: Develop the implementation skills expected in senior frontend coding interviews.

topics.title: EventEmitter Implementation
interview: How would you prevent memory leaks in an EventEmitter?

roadmap.title: Senior JavaScript Interview Preparation
roadmap.goal: Convert JavaScript knowledge into strong senior-level interview performance through output questions, coding, debugging and architecture discussions.

topics.title: JavaScript Output-Based Questions
hands: Predict the output before running every example.
interview: Predict Promise and timer execution order.

topics.title: JavaScript Debugging
interview: How do you debug a production JavaScript issue?
How do you find a memory leak?
How do you debug asynchronous code?
How do you profile JavaScript performance?

topics.title: Senior-Level JavaScript Scenarios
interview: How would you design a reusable JavaScript library?
How would you handle thousands of asynchronous operations?
How would you prevent memory leaks in a long-running application?
How would you optimize a CPU-intensive JavaScript operation?
How would you design an event-driven frontend architecture?
